content: A GitLab team member should allow up to 5 stock market trading days for shares to be reflected in E*TRADE after the release process starts [1].

messages.content:
You answer questions about the GitLab company handbook using ONLY the numbered passages provided.
- Base every statement on the passages and cite them like [1] or [2][3].
- If the passages do not contain the answer, reply exactly: "I don't know based on the handbook." Do not guess or use outside knowledge.
- If the answer depends on a country, entity or situation, say which one the passage covers.
- Be concise: at most 3 sentences.

Passages:
[1] [Equity Compensation > About Your Ownership in GitLab > RSU Vesting & Grant Cadence]
RSUs are grants of shares of the Company's common stock, the vesting of which is based on the requisite service requirement.

Per our [SAFE framework](/handbook/legal/safe-framework/), we do not add specific dates to the handbook regarding equity. For more information on grant cadence & vesting, please see the following [slide deck](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/176GjzzcrEpdMz9X5NPD5c_YojhD33KPO5f1jGiG9j8c/edit?slide=id.p#slide=id.p).

- RSUs begin vesting on the corresponding grant date.
- RSUs are reviewed for approval quarterly.
- Promotion and Refresh Grants do not require a cliff, begin vesting quarterly for three-year vest.
- Shares are not expected to post to E*TRADE on the vest date itself. The release process starts after market close, when the closing stock price is available, and the taxable value of the shares can be determined. From there, please allow up to 5 stock market trading days for shares to be reflected in E*TRADE.

[2] [GitLab Offboarding FAQ > Timing > Total Rewards - Benefits > What if I am a designated Insider?]
If you decide to trade in GitLab's stock or other securities prior to the 90th day following the end of your employment or service relationship with GitLab, we suggest that you evaluate whether you have MNPI prior to trading.

[3] [Equity Compensation > About Your Ownership in GitLab > Purchasing GTLB Stock]
If you would like to purchase GTLB shares, this must be done through your E*TRADE retail account during an open trading window. Submit an Equity Compass ticket from your GitLab dashboard, so the Stock Administration team can coordinate the consent process to track your GTLB retail shares.

[4] [Equity Compensation > About Your Ownership in GitLab > E-TRADE: Exercising your Shares in an Open Trading Window]
For trading in an open trading window, please find the following instructions for specifics on exercise and trading options.

- [GitLab Stock Plan Non-US](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1pBZsudczsgSv_xxPEJlMc1wA0TumDm97/view)
- [GitLab Stock Plan RSUs & Stock Options](https://drive.google.com/file/d/16Hby-UdCKA-BJDHvZQ9bpbU5cEQlzeUE/view)

[5] [Equity Compensation > About Your Ownership in GitLab > Exercising Your Options]
You may exercise and hold your options (cash exercise) even outside of an open trading window. If you are a Designated Insider, please submit an Equity Compass ticket from your GitLab dashboard for assistance on exercising and managing your E-TRADE account. Team members will have 5 trading days to execute their exercise. Please seek advice from your financial advisor or tax advisor prior to processing your exercise.

[6] [Equity Compensation > About Your Ownership in GitLab > Employee Stock Purchase Plan ("ESPP") > E*TRADE ESPP Training Events from May 2026]
- [Educational Session for US Team Members](https://events.zoom.us/ev/AkARIQfwP3wBQQDahGkqABp38aSCr_4NOePCm-cncoIMyfhSBVPM~AlqGb8CRN6B9zP17Yr5pjQxEii_C6ZHmkKOhe5aSZY5C_k1Hjzek3Rxgeg)
